title: RL Agent
text: Reinforcement learning agent, 6 inputs, 2 outputs; {Agent object} sets the agent to train, {Generate greedy policy block}, {External action inputs} adds input ports for external action, {Last action input} adds input ports for last action applied, {Cumulative reward output} adds cumulative reward output port and {Use strict observation data types} sets the enforce strict data types for observations. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: observation
ports.summary: Environment observations scalar | vector | nonvirtual bus

ports.name: isdone
ports.summary: Flag to terminate episode simulation logical

ports.name: last action
ports.summary: Last action applied to environment signal scalar | vector

ports.name: action
ports.summary: Agent action scalar | vector | nonvirtual bus

params.name: Agent object
params.values: Agent to train agentObj (default) | agent object

params.name: Generate greedy policy block
params.values: Generate greedy policy block controller button

params.name: External action inputs
params.values: Add input ports for external action off (default) | on

params.name: Last action input
params.values: Add input ports for last action applied to environment off (default) | on

params.name: Cumulative reward output
params.values: Add cumulative reward output port off (default) | on

params.name: Use strict observation data types
params.values: Enforce strict data types for observations off (default) | on
